items.title: Cerebras Deploys Trillion-Parameter AI Models
items.summary: Cerebras has successfully deployed AI models with a staggering trillion parameters, pushing the boundaries of what is possible in AI model training and deployment. This development is significant for engineers and developers as it opens new avenues for complex problem-solving and enhances capabilities in various AI applications.

items.title: We should be more ambitious with the software we build
items.summary: The article argues for a more ambitious approach to software development, encouraging developers to push the limits of what technology can achieve. This perspective is crucial for fostering innovation and creativity in web engineering.

items.title: Node2Shell evolves to HTTP2Shell, blast radius affects many HTTP libs and apps
items.summary: The evolution of Node2Shell to HTTP2Shell introduces significant vulnerabilities affecting numerous HTTP libraries and applications. Developers need to be aware of these changes to ensure their applications remain secure against potential exploits.

items.title: The Goose Programming Language
items.summary: The introduction of the Goose programming language offers a new tool for developers, focusing on simplicity and efficiency in coding. This open-source language could enhance productivity and foster community-driven development.

items.title: America has lost 200k of jobs in media, film and the arts. How much is AI?
items.summary: This article explores the impact of AI on job losses in creative sectors, highlighting the need for developers and engineers to consider the societal implications of their work. Understanding this dynamic is essential for responsible innovation in AI technologies.
